instructions: To embed a returns reason capture form on Wix, follow these steps:
1. Go to your Wix site's editor and click on the "Add App" button in the top bar.
2. Search for the "Form Builder" app and click "Add App" to install it.
3. Drag and drop the "Form" element from the Form Builder app into your site's page.
4. Click on the form element to open its settings and select the "Form Settings" tab.
5. In the "Form Settings" tab, click on the "Add Field" button and select "Text Field" as the field type.
6. Name the field as "Returns Reason" and set its placeholder text to "Please enter the reason for return".
7. Click on the "Save" button to save the form settings.
8. To capture the returns reason, you'll need to add a form submission handler to your site. To do this, go to your Wix site's settings and click on the "Advanced" tab.
9. In the "Advanced" tab, click on the "Code" button and select "HTML/CSS" as the code type.
